name: How long does an open-concept kitchen remodel typically take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does an open-concept kitchen remodel typically take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an open-concept kitchen remodel varies significantly based on its complexity, particularly if structural changes like load-bearing wall removal are involved. After our initial consultation and detailed design planning, which includes CAD-supported layouts, we provide a transparent project timeline. Generally, construction phases for such a substantial renovation can range from 8 to 16 weeks, excluding the design and permitting coordination phases. We prioritize clear communication throughout, keeping you informed on scheduling and milestones from concept to final walkthrough, ensuring a managed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Open-concept kitchen remodels vary in duration, typically 8-16 weeks for construction after design and permitting. AKN Design Group provides a transparent project timeline, dependent on complexity like wall removal.
